statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 19% remains in the low band and Stress 47% is elevated, with the BOJ decision and the Ueda press conference both resolved and oil extending its decline.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The BOJ hike and the Ueda press conference have both passed without a hawkish surprise, and the yen weakened rather than strengthened, so the carry-unwind mechanism that would normally justify broad protection around this decision is not active. NQ has extended to a fresh session high at 29,938.50 and holds near it, which is a mild directional tilt, but the whole Globex band is only about 0.45% wide and retracement from the high has remained available. Cross-assets are de-escalating rather than aligning: WTI is down 2.2% near $99.6 as Saudi Arabia restores East-West pipeline capacity, and the 10-year yield is flat at 4.93% after retreating about 10bp from 19-year highs. Conditional risk is therefore concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z US cash open on quadruple-witching expiry rather than spread across the session, and Tail remains below the block threshold.
headline: NQ holds the top of a narrow overnight band near 29,915 after a fresh session high during the Ueda Q&A; September quadruple-witching expiry frames the US session
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73% (+501.92 points), in a relief rally after Wednesday's 25bp Federal Reserve hike to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than three years, with VIX closing down 12.8% at 15.44. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% at 02:45Z, a 31-year high, on a 7-2 vote: board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato dissented, arguing that inflation is not yet demand-driven and that growth risks are skewed lower. Governor Ueda's press conference from 06:30Z restated a commitment to adjusting accommodation in line with economic activity, prices and financial conditions, without signalling an acceleration. That combination has kept the yen weak: USD/JPY trades at 157.229, up 0.80% and at two-week yen lows. A weaker yen after a hike is the opposite of a carry unwind, so the transmission channel that makes a central-bank second leg dangerous for mean-reversion strategies is not active. NQ December futures trade near 29,915, about +0.58%, after printing a fresh session high at 29,938.50 during the Ueda Q&A; the Globex band is 29,804-29,938, roughly 0.45% wide. Price sits in the upper part of that band, which is a mild directional tilt and the reason the dominant mode is read as trend-up, but the range is tight and the pullback from the high has held, so the path is a grind rather than a one-way extension. Cross-assets are de-escalating rather than aligning behind a trend: WTI trades near $99.63, down 2.24% and falling for a third consecutive session as Saudi Arabia moves to restore about half the capacity of its drone-damaged East-West pipeline within days, and the 10-year Treasury yield is flat at 4.93% after retreating roughly 10bp on Thursday from 19-year highs. Falling oil and stable yields remove two of the amplifiers that would otherwise support a persistent no-retracement path. The day's structural feature is the September quadruple-witching expiration, which settles at the 20:00Z cash close, with August Industrial Production at 13:15Z, a Fed Bowman speech at 13:30Z and the CB Leading Index at 14:00Z framing the US open. Conditional risk is concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z window, where opening continuation on an already-extended index is either confirmed or rejected; outside it the observed structure does not support a Tail reading above the watch band. CME equity futures halt for the weekend from 21:00Z, after which no live price path exists and Tail falls to the low-band floor.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 64% to the low 40s before ticking back to 50% as the BOJ decision approached. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced; Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared. From 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence steady near 87%, and that regime held through the BOJ statement and into the Ueda press conference without a disorderly repricing.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry one narrow conditional-risk peak. Tail holds in the low band through the European morning while the BOJ message is digested, then moves into the watch band at 12:00Z as US pre-market positioning builds for quadruple-witching expiry. It reaches 23% at 13:00Z, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the cash open coincide, and the single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 14:00Z at Tail 25%, covering the window in which opening continuation is confirmed or rejected. Tail then eases through the US afternoon, with a secondary Stress peak at the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 12-15% and Confidence eases into the solid band for the remaining slots.
